title: Birth certificate
label: Birth certificate
description: Employer-dependent document request. This catalog has no evidence that a birth certificate is required for every first job.
notes: Keep this item only if your employer requests it, and confirm the accepted issuing authority and format before ordering. Republic Act No. 11261 concerns government-fee waivers for some employment documents, but this catalog has not verified its covered transactions, eligibility, proof, exceptions, or current implementation. Ask your barangay and the issuing agency before relying on a waiver.
guideInstructions: A birth certificate is not confirmed as a universal first-job requirement. If your employer requests one, ask which issuing authority and format it accepts before ordering. RA 11261 concerns fee waivers for some employment documents, but this guide has not verified the covered transactions, eligibility, proof, exceptions, or current procedure. Ask your barangay and the issuing agency before relying on a waiver.

title: TIN
label: TIN
description: An employer may request TIN information or registration during hiring. No current BIR procedure is confirmed in this guide.

RA 11261 concerns fee waivers for some employment documents, but this catalog has not verified its covered transactions, eligibility, proof, exceptions, or current implementation. guideInstructions: The current BIR route for a first-time employee, required information, who files, and timing have not been confirmed. If an employer asks for TIN details or registration, ask which step it will handle and confirm current instructions with BIR before acting. RA 11261 concerns fee waivers for some employment documents, but this guide has not verified TIN coverage, eligibility, proof, exceptions, or current procedure. title: SSS number
label: SSS number
description: SSS provides an online first-time SS Number application and says an employer reports a prospective employee for coverage starting on the first day of employment.
notes: If you may already have an SS Number, confirm your record with SSS before starting another application. SSS directs people without an SS Number to apply online or through a branch E-Center. The online procedure asks for identity, contact, address, social-status and place-of-birth details, plus beneficiary information when applicable; it emails a continuation link valid for five calendar days. Uploading a supporting document is optional in the described online application. The linked SSS ID list describes identity evidence but is not a universal upload checklist. SSS says the employer reports a prospective employee for coverage effective on the first day of employment. The page does not state an application fee or employer-specific onboarding deadline.
guideInstructions: If you may already have an SS Number, confirm your record with SSS before starting another application. For a person without an SS Number, SSS directs applicants to its online application or an SSS branch E-Center. The online flow requests registrant, contact, address, social-status and place-of-birth details, beneficiary information when applicable, and personal-record details. Its email continuation link expires after five calendar days. The page permits applicants to proceed without uploading supporting documents; its separate valid-ID list is not a universal upload checklist. Do not share account details with Requisito. The page does not state an application fee or employer-specific onboarding deadline. SSS says the employer reports a prospective employee for coverage effective on the first day of employment; confirm onboarding details with the employer.

title: PhilHealth number
label: PhilHealth number
description: PhilHealth lists workers with an established employee-employer relationship as qualified direct contributors; its page does not establish first-time registration steps.
notes: This classification applies when an employee-employer relationship is established. Ask the employer how enrollment or record updates are handled; the reviewed page does not say who files or what documents are needed.
guideInstructions: When an employee-employer relationship is established, PhilHealth lists government and private workers in that relationship as direct contributors. The page does not provide first-time enrollment steps, required documents, timing, or division of work with the employer. Ask the employer and use PhilHealth's current official member services before acting.

title: Pag-IBIG number
label: Pag-IBIG number
description: Preparation prompt only. No accessible current official source in this review establishes a first-time employee's registration steps or whether the applicant must act before onboarding.
notes: This is not an instruction to register, pay, or create a new number. Ask the employer whether a membership step applies and who handles it; confirm the current process directly with Pag-IBIG.
guideInstructions: No current Pag-IBIG registration procedure, first-time employee applicability, or document list is confirmed here. Use this only as a reminder to ask the employer whether an action applies and who handles it, then consult current official Pag-IBIG instructions before visiting, submitting information, or paying. This guide does not tell you to register.

title: NBI clearance
label: NBI clearance
description: An employer may request an NBI clearance; this catalog does not establish that every employer requires one.
notes: This is an employer-specific request, not a universal first-job requirement. RA 11261 concerns fee waivers for some employment documents, but this catalog has not verified NBI coverage, eligibility, proof, exceptions, or current implementation. Ask your barangay and NBI before relying on a waiver. The Citizen's Charter page's date and Davao applicability are unconfirmed.
guideInstructions: Ask the employer whether an NBI clearance is required and which purpose or timing applies. RA 11261 concerns fee waivers for some employment documents, but this guide has not verified NBI coverage, eligibility, proof, exceptions, or current procedure. Ask your barangay and NBI before relying on a waiver. The Citizen's Charter page lists two valid government-issued IDs and service paths, but its date and Davao applicability are unclear. Confirm current requirements and fees directly with NBI.

title: Confirm your passport application type
label: Confirm your passport application type
description: Illustrative preparation prompt; it does not determine eligibility or official requirements.
notes: Identify whether you are applying for a passport for the first time or asking about a renewal, then confirm the correct route with DFA.
guideInstructions: Use the official DFA Consular Affairs site as a starting point. Confirm the application category and current instructions there before preparing documents or making plans.

title: Confirm instructions for a first application
label: Confirm instructions for a first application

notes: Ask DFA to confirm the current first-application document list and accepted document formats for your circumstances.
guideInstructions: Confirm the current first-application instructions directly with DFA. This checklist does not specify identity documents, copies, or eligibility.

title: Confirm instructions for a renewal

notes: Ask DFA to confirm whether your existing passport and circumstances use the renewal route and what current instructions apply.
guideInstructions: Confirm the current renewal route and document instructions directly with DFA. This checklist does not determine whether a specific passport qualifies for renewal.

label: Check appointment and application instructions

title: Confirm current fees and next steps
label: Confirm current fees and next steps

guideInstructions: Confirm current fees, processing expectations, payment options, and release instructions with DFA before paying or planning around a date.

title: Review application and appointment steps
label: Review application and appointment steps
